instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll mechanics are enabled.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, filters, inputs, project cards, links).
Make sure POST /api/contact endpoint is correctly called by the contact form.
Display real IST local clock in the header or footer updated every second.
Provide a smooth dark/light theme toggle button while maintaining high contrast in both themes.
Implement the rotating circular text badge ('Hire Me') with CSS keyframe animation or Framer Motion.
Ensure all skills mentioned in Vipan's profile are explicitly displayed in the Skills Bento section.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create layered depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Do NOT use universal transition 'transition: all' as it breaks CSS transforms. Use specific properties like transform and opacity.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect human natural reading patterns.
Always include data-testid in kebab-case for all buttons, inputs, links, and cards.
Use Sonner toast notifications for user interactions like form submission or email copy.
